elements.text: Doctoral (PhD) students and other postgraduate research students
Peer writing groups: writing groups, circles, retreats or peer feedback on academic writing
Working alone or usual supervision (no group)
Writing confidence or self-efficacy; also productivity and writing experience

criteria.label: Research students
criteria.description: Participants are doctoral or other postgraduate research students (or the results for them are reported separately)

criteria.label: Peer writing group
criteria.description: The study concerns a group-based peer writing activity: a writing group, circle, retreat, boot camp or structured peer feedback on writing

criteria.label: Writing outcome
criteria.description: An outcome about writing is reported: confidence, self-efficacy, productivity, quality or the students' experience of writing

criteria.label: Original study
criteria.description: Primary research or an evaluation with data (quantitative, qualitative or mixed); not an editorial, opinion piece or literature review

fields.label: Design
fields.description: study design, e.g. pre-post survey, qualitative interviews, mixed methods, controlled comparison

fields.label: Participants
fields.description: number and type of students (e.g. 24 doctoral nursing students)

fields.label: Group format
fields.description: what the group did, how often and for how long

fields.label: Comparison
fields.description: comparison group if any (working alone, usual supervision), else 'none'

fields.label: Confidence / self-efficacy result
fields.description: the reported effect on writing confidence or self-efficacy, with numbers where given

fields.label: Other writing outcomes
fields.description: productivity, quality, wellbeing or experience, as reported

notes: Few controlled comparisons are likely: most studies of writing groups are single-group evaluations or qualitative, so 'compared with working alone' may only be answerable indirectly. PubMed covers mostly health-related doctoral programmes; education databases (ERIC, Scopus) are needed for a full review. Check whether master's research students should count as research students.
